answer:
The OpenAI-compatible endpoint that lets apps stream speech audio generated by Ollama on macOS is `/v1/audio/speech`. This information is supported by the following context:

1. From the release notes: "Ollama can now generate [speech](https://docs.ollama.com/capabilities/speech) on macOS. `ollama run` plays text or a chat model's reply aloud as the audio is generated, and apps can stream audio through the OpenAI-compatible `/v1/audio/speech` endpoint."  
   - [ollama/v0.40.11.md (lines 1-12)](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/tag/v0.40.11)

2. Additionally, the details of the endpoint are described in the documentation:  
   - "/`v1/audio/speech` - Generates audio with speech models. The response streams while audio is generated."  
   - [ollama/docs/api/openai-compatibility.md (lines 318-335)](ollama/docs/api/openai-compatibility.md)

These references confirm that `/v1/audio/speech` is the endpoint used for streaming speech audio.
